title: Colpey Calling x The Fix [2]
content:
20 February 2015

Colpey Calling x The Fix is back once more, making your ears sweaty, your glutes clenched and your groin tensed.

This week we welcomed Bristol’s Bodywork DJ collective member Prince of Persia, who provided us with a superb guest mix.

Bodywork celebrate their 1st Birthday on 6th march with a full-on workout at the Crofters Rights with Bill Brewster and Banoffee Pies. Keep those lunges tight.
